lines.text: Jesus arrived in the region of the Gadarenes and was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs.
The men shouted at Jesus and asked if He had come to torture them before the appointed time.
A large herd of pigs was feeding, and the demons begged Jesus to send them into the herd.
Jesus told the demons to go, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the Jordan.
Those tending the pigs ran to town and reported everything, and the whole town begged Jesus to bless their region.
